line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.2: Recently abandoned sectors retain their previous owner for coalition checks when subsequently conquered.
* Previous ownership is recognized for 4 hours.
* Add-Ons 1.7.4: Conqueror text moved here.

* Recalculate Phanon protection if Phanon lost the sector.

* Conquer the sector as usual.

* Zero Hour Coordinated Invasion ends
* Lasertower cleanup used to be handled here. It is handled in !station.signal.killed.
* End of $sector.owner faction.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Updated writing.
